ideas.title: ALiEM Simple Accounting
ideas.description: Replace $20/month Xero subscription with a self-hosted permasolution for ALiEM LLC accounting. Tracks expenses by Schedule C category, auto-imports transactions from Ally, BofA (2 accounts), and Chase Business Ink via SimpleFIN ($15/year). Generates annual tax summaries for accountant. Single-user, runs on Mac Studio, Dropbox-synced for backup.
ideas.notes:
## Why
- Xero costs $240/year, way overkill for simple LLC with ~10-15 expenses/month
- Downgraded from S-Corp to LLC, no longer need payroll/contractor features
- Only need: expense categorization, income tracking, Schedule C summary

## Key Design Decisions
- **SimpleFIN ($15/year) NOT Plaid (~$500/month)** for bank sync
- **localStorage + Dropbox backup** (repo lives in Dropbox folder)
- **Same stack as Kindling** (Next.js 14, Tailwind, Lucide)
- **Local-only** — no deployment needed, runs on Mac Studio
- **No auth needed** — single user, local browser

## Accounts
- Ally Checking
- BofA Savings
- BofA Checking
- Chase Business Ink (credit card)

## Income Sources
- Google AdSense (monthly, direct deposit)
- Amazon Affiliates (monthly, direct deposit)
- Sponsors (~2x/year, physical check)

## Build Phases
1. **MVP**: Manual entry + CSV import + Schedule C categories + dashboard
2. **Automation**: SimpleFIN integration + vendor rules + auto-categorize
3. **Tax Reporting**: Schedule C summary + quarterly P&L + annual export
4. **Polish**: Search, bulk categorize, split transactions, charts

## Cost Savings
- Current: $240/year (Xero)
- New: $15/year (SimpleFIN)
- Savings: $225/year forever

## Full spec: docs/aliem-accounting-app-spec.md
